task: Welcome to another exciting session of TextWorld! Here is how to play! First off, attempt to go east. After that, go to the south. Following that, take a trip west. Then, try to move south. That done, make an effort to take a trip east. If you can do that, open the passageway. Then, attempt to venture east. Then, make an effort to take a trip north. Then, retrieve the key from the stand in the garage. Once that's all handled, you can stop!
description:
You are in an ordinary kind of place. That is to say, you're in a playroom.

Oh, great. Here's a dresser. Make a note of this, you might have to put stuff on or in it later on. You make out a closed coffer, which looks ordinary, nearby.

There is an unblocked exit to the east. You don't like doors? Why not try going south, that entranceway is unblocked.

There is a banana on the floor.
